description: This PHP source file defines the 'Reminder' class, which manages reminders within the SuiteCRM/ SugarCRM system. The class includes methods for handling reminder data retrieval, saving, email notifications, popups, and upgrade procedures. It interacts with other modules like BeanFactory, DBManagerFactory, and utilizes global services like $timedate and $app_strings. The file also manages reminder-related behaviors such as loading default values based on user preferences and migrating old reminder data.

classes.name: Reminder
classes.description: Represents and manages reminders for events like meetings and calls within the SuiteCRM system, including creating, updating, notifying, and upgrading reminder data.

methods.name: saveRemindersDataJson
methods.description: Saves multiple reminders from JSON data, parsing JSON and invoking internal save method.

methods.name: saveRemindersData
methods.description: Processes and persists reminders data for specific event modules and IDs, handling creation and deletion.

methods.name: loadRemindersDataJson
methods.description: Loads reminders data in JSON format for a specific event module and ID.

methods.name: loadRemindersData
methods.description: Loads reminders data as an array for a given event module and ID, with optional duplication handling.

methods.name: addNotifications
methods.description: Generates popup and alert reminders for the user, considering event timings and user preferences.

methods.name: makeAlertURL
methods.description: Constructs a URL pointing to the detail view of a specific module record.
